title: wulfenia alpina
intro: Wulfenia alpina, commonly known as Alpine Wulfenia or Austrian Alpine, is a rare, alpine plant belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Wulfenia alpina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, such as wulfeniols and wulfenine. These constituents may contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
